description: Java entity class representing a User, mapped to the 'users' table, with fields for user details and timestamp management, including lifecycle hooks for persistence events.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing a user with fields for ID, username, email, display name, active status, lock status, and timestamps, including lifecycle callbacks for persisting and updating.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked before persisting a new User entity; initializes ID and timestamps if null.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked before updating an existing User entity; updates the 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the user is active.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Returns whether the user account is locked.
